consequence.statement: Workflows using fluxcd/flux2/action have the latest Flux version determined without querying the GitHub API; the action still determines a latest version, but the resolution mechanism changed.
consequence.remediation: Verify that workflows using fluxcd/flux2/action still resolve the expected latest Flux version.

assertion.statement: The fluxcd/flux2 GitHub Action now determines the latest Flux version without using the GitHub API.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence does not state which usages of fluxcd/flux2/action are affected (e.g. whether the workflow pins a version input), and no available predicate can express whether an environment's CI workflows use the action.
